scientific_limits.en: {"original_inventory_number":811,"taxon":"Offacolus kingi","representation":"living-reconstruction","scope":"Whole Silurian animal. Main outline/scale is Siveter2003 Fig4 virtual fossil, about7mm long; caption provides no accession. Same-species C.29557 used solely to clarify appendages, not covert scale substitution.","scale":{"units":"meters","total_length_approx":0.007,"shield_length_estimate":0.0026,"shield_width_estimate":0.0025,"shield_height_estimate":0.002,"rear_body_length_estimate":0.002,"tail_length_estimate":0.0024,"uncertainty":"7mm is rounded caption length; component dimensions approximate same image proportions, not caliper measurements. Live posture and oblique image imply ~20percent proportional uncertainty."},"anatomy":["High arch/box-like cephalic shield with an open anterior gape. Reduced tapering rear body, free anterior tergites then compact fused posterior unit, narrow articulated tail spine. Not modern horseshoe outline.","Seven cephalic appendage pairs: slender long chelicerae; pairsII-V robust segmented brush-bearing exopods pointing forward/up and ventrally oriented endopods. Separate body-wall insertion for inner/outer branches per2012 revision, not forks on leg shafts.","PairVI locomotory inner branch with small outer tendril interpretation rather than a fifth large brush; pairVII short flap-like. Preserve small conservative terminals, not giant claws.","Use2013 revised dorsal counting: four anterior tergites (the fourth previously grouped posteriorly), three fused posterior segments, separate telson-base boss not counted as an eighth trunk segment. Six paired ventral opercula: first three more developed respiratory lamellae, last three reduced covers."],"restoration_boundaries":["Fig4 is a fossil-derived digital reconstruction, not an ordinary surface photo or color evidence. Build original geometry, never import published reconstruction mesh.","Unknown accession of Fig4 remains unknown; C.29557 in2025 Fig1C/2C-D is same-species anatomical comparator and visibly smaller, not the7mm measured individual.","Brush feeding function is hypothesis, not behavior proven by fossil; stance/color and minor missing fine bristles inferred. No invented compound eyes.","2025 figures contain modern shrimp and other genera: only Offacolus1C and2C-D informative here."]}
